title: PostNumberForSingleReachNumber
description: Represents a request to add a phone number for Single Number Reach.

name.description: Name associated with the phone number.

enabled.description: If `true`, the phone number is enabled.

doNotForwardCallsEnabled.description: Note that this setting attempts to prevent the Single Number Reach (SNR) destination from forwarding the call. The SNR destination may or may not respect the indication provided hence, it may still be forwarded, and this setting has no impact on the user's own forwarding services.

answerConfirmationEnabled.description: If `true`, answer confirmation is enabled. The default value is `false`.
